snippet.title: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🎪 Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus launches on Steam November 13!

Aim the spotlight, Let the crowd do the smashing!

A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!

From bouncing footballs to lightning-filled arenas, discover new ways to smash your way through the circus. Short runs, permanent upgrades, and plenty of reasons to put on one more show.

🎮 Try the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4918810/
🔗Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/b2gYmSBaV

Developed by Punk Func Games.

#PinataSmash #IncrementalGame #IndieGame
